measurement: Unchanged original instructions at original addresses in a freestanding 32-bit Linux process, including actual internal calls to HasSpecialPersonageUnits and Unit_GetSquadCount.
input_encoding: Two little-endian uint32 words (zero, stack address), then 800 bytes beginning 32 bytes before the stack.
output_encoding: Three original EAX uint32 returns in max-tier, normal-combat, special-personage order, then all 800 live bytes.
update_rule: Stream hashes may change only after fresh original instruction measurement.
limits: Isolated instruction execution; no game startup, visual or campaign claim.
Public fixture includes hashes and a generated corpus; original executable bytes remain private artifacts.
